title: 短剧｜启动耗时与诊断
description: 客户端自报启动诊断。已知观察不等于全部尝试；缺失不补0，slow/final去重，旧/新版本与降级口径分层。读近14天；遥测失败不影响视频。

list.name: release
list.label: 前端版本
list.query: SELECT '__all__' AS __value,'全部' AS __text UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT client_release AS __value,client_release AS __text FROM miniapp_analytics.drama_playback_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen_at) AND first_seen_at>=now()-interval '14 days' AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND client_release IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 2

list.name: platform
list.label: 平台
list.query: SELECT '__all__' AS __value,'全部' AS __text UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT platform AS __value,platform AS __text FROM miniapp_analytics.drama_playback_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen_at) AND first_seen_at>=now()-interval '14 days' AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND platform IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 2

list.name: entry
list.label: 入口
list.query: SELECT '__all__' AS __value,'全部' AS __text UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT entry AS __value,entry AS __text FROM miniapp_analytics.drama_playback_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen_at) AND first_seen_at>=now()-interval '14 days' AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND entry IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 2

list.name: video
list.label: 视频ID
list.query: SELECT '__all__' AS __value,'全部' AS __text UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT video_id AS __value,video_id AS __text FROM miniapp_analytics.drama_playback_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen_at) AND first_seen_at>=now()-interval '14 days' AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND video_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 2

list.name: measurement
list.label: 口径版本
list.query: SELECT '__all__' AS __value,'全部' AS __text UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT measurement_version::text AS __value,measurement_version::text AS __text FROM miniapp_analytics.drama_playback_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen_at) AND first_seen_at>=now()-interval '14 days' AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND measurement_version::text IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 2

list.name: frame
list.label: 首帧测量方式
list.query: SELECT '__all__' AS __value,'全部' AS __text UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT frame_method AS __value,frame_method AS __text FROM miniapp_analytics.drama_playback_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen_at) AND first_seen_at>=now()-interval '14 days' AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND frame_method IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 2

panels.title: 采集覆盖与结果：已知观察，不等于全部尝试
panels.description: 两分钟是完整性观察窗口，不是播放超时。完全未送达不可见；丢失率需与Railway接收/失败计数核对。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "已知观察",count(*) FILTER(WHERE start_received_at IS NOT NULL) AS "有开始报告",
count(*) FILTER(WHERE final_received_at IS NOT NULL) AS "有终态",count(*) FILTER(WHERE outcome='playing') AS "成功",
count(*) FILTER(WHERE outcome='error') AS "错误",count(*) FILTER(WHERE outcome='autoplay_blocked') AS "自动播放受限",
count(*) FILTER(WHERE outcome IN ('left','switched')) AS "退出或切换",count(*) FILTER(WHERE outcome='background') AS "后台",
count(*) FILTER(WHERE final_received_at IS NULL AND first_seen_at<now()-interval '2 minutes') AS "成熟窗口无终态",
count(*) FILTER(WHERE first_seen_at>=now()-interval '2 minutes' AND final_received_at IS NULL) AS "仍在观察窗口",
count(*) FILTER(WHERE network_status='available') AS "有网络细节",count(*) FILTER(WHERE event_order_anomaly) AS "事件顺序异常",
count(*) FILTER(WHERE frame_processing_ms IS NOT NULL) AS "可读首帧处理N",count(*) FILTER(WHERE diagnostic_summary#>>'{longTasks,support}'='supported') AS "支持长任务N",count(*) FILTER(WHERE diagnostic_summary#>>'{longTasks,truncated}'='true' OR network_summary->>'truncated'='true') AS "诊断截断N",count(DISTINCT video_id) AS "视频数",count(DISTINCT session_id) AS "随机会话数",max(last_received_at) AS "最后落表时间"
FROM miniapp_analytics.drama_playback_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen_at) AND first_seen_at>=now()-interval '14 days' AND environment=${environment:sqlstring}
AND (${release:sqlstring}='__all__' OR client_release=${release:sqlstring})
AND (${platform:sqlstring}='__all__' OR platform=${platform:sqlstring})
AND (${entry:sqlstring}='__all__' OR entry=${entry:sqlstring})
AND (${video:sqlstring}='__all__' OR video_id=${video:sqlstring})
AND (${measurement:sqlstring}='__all__' OR measurement_version::text=${measurement:sqlstring})
AND (${frame:sqlstring}='__all__' OR frame_method=${frame:sqlstring})

panels.title: 成功启动：首帧与启动完成分位（毫秒）
panels.description: 只统计成功启动，timeupdate降级须按测量方式分层；各阶段P95不能相加。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT metric AS "指标",count(ms) AS "有效样本N",percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY ms) AS "P50_ms",
percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY ms) AS "P90_ms",percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY ms) AS "P95_ms",
CASE WHEN count(ms)>=1000 THEN percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY ms) END AS "P99_ms",
CASE WHEN count(ms)<100 THEN 'P95样本不足，勿作稳定性结论' ELSE '结合平台/视频/会话覆盖判断' END AS "样本说明"
FROM (SELECT * FROM miniapp_analytics.drama_playback_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen_at) AND first_seen_at>=now()-interval '14 days' AND environment=${environment:sqlstring}
AND (${release:sqlstring}='__all__' OR client_release=${release:sqlstring})
AND (${platform:sqlstring}='__all__' OR platform=${platform:sqlstring})
AND (${entry:sqlstring}='__all__' OR entry=${entry:sqlstring})
AND (${video:sqlstring}='__all__' OR video_id=${video:sqlstring})
AND (${measurement:sqlstring}='__all__' OR measurement_version::text=${measurement:sqlstring})
AND (${frame:sqlstring}='__all__' OR frame_method=${frame:sqlstring}) AND outcome='playing') f CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('首帧',first_frame_ms),('启动完成',startup_ms)) v(metric,ms)
GROUP BY metric

panels.title: 启动完成趋势（成功样本，毫秒）
panels.description: 15分钟桶；每桶N请结合观察数趋势，少样本波动不视为确定退化。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(first_seen_at,'15m'),percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY startup_ms) AS p50_ms,percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY startup_ms) AS p95_ms FROM miniapp_analytics.drama_playback_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen_at) AND first_seen_at>=now()-interval '14 days' AND environment=${environment:sqlstring}
AND (${release:sqlstring}='__all__' OR client_release=${release:sqlstring})
AND (${platform:sqlstring}='__all__' OR platform=${platform:sqlstring})
AND (${entry:sqlstring}='__all__' OR entry=${entry:sqlstring})
AND (${video:sqlstring}='__all__' OR video_id=${video:sqlstring})
AND (${measurement:sqlstring}='__all__' OR measurement_version::text=${measurement:sqlstring})
AND (${frame:sqlstring}='__all__' OR frame_method=${frame:sqlstring}) AND outcome='playing' AND startup_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(first_seen_at,'15m'),count(*) AS known_observations,count(*) FILTER(WHERE outcome='playing') AS successful_observations FROM miniapp_analytics.drama_playback_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen_at) AND first_seen_at>=now()-interval '14 days' AND environment=${environment:sqlstring}
AND (${release:sqlstring}='__all__' OR client_release=${release:sqlstring})
AND (${platform:sqlstring}='__all__' OR platform=${platform:sqlstring})
AND (${entry:sqlstring}='__all__' OR entry=${entry:sqlstring})
AND (${video:sqlstring}='__all__' OR video_id=${video:sqlstring})
AND (${measurement:sqlstring}='__all__' OR measurement_version::text=${measurement:sqlstring})
AND (${frame:sqlstring}='__all__' OR frame_method=${frame:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 阶段耗时：完成区间的条件分位（毫秒）
panels.description: 各阶段分母可能不同，缺失/逆序为NULL。元数据→画面数据不是纯下载，画面数据→首帧不是纯解码。

targets.rawSql:
WITH f AS (SELECT * FROM miniapp_analytics.drama_playback_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen_at) AND first_seen_at>=now()-interval '14 days' AND environment=${environment:sqlstring}
AND (${release:sqlstring}='__all__' OR client_release=${release:sqlstring})
AND (${platform:sqlstring}='__all__' OR platform=${platform:sqlstring})
AND (${entry:sqlstring}='__all__' OR entry=${entry:sqlstring})
AND (${video:sqlstring}='__all__' OR video_id=${video:sqlstring})
AND (${measurement:sqlstring}='__all__' OR measurement_version::text=${measurement:sqlstring})
AND (${frame:sqlstring}='__all__' OR frame_method=${frame:sqlstring})) SELECT stage AS "阶段",count(*) AS "已知观察N",count(*) FILTER(WHERE reached_start) AS "达到阶段起点N",count(ms) AS "阶段完成N",percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY ms) AS "P50_ms",percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY ms) AS "P95_ms",max(ms) AS "最大_ms" FROM f CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('进入→设置源',entry_to_source_ms,true),('源→元数据',source_to_metadata_ms,entry_to_source_ms IS NOT NULL),('元数据→画面数据',metadata_to_data_ms,summary#>'{marks,metadata}' IS NOT NULL),('画面数据→首帧',data_to_frame_ms,summary#>'{marks,loadeddata}' IS NOT NULL),('首帧→启动完成',frame_to_startup_ms,first_frame_ms IS NOT NULL)) v(stage,ms,reached_start) GROUP BY stage

panels.title: 成功启动耗时分布（含40秒以上尾部）
panels.description: 失败/后台/退出不填0、不混入成功分布。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN startup_ms<1000 THEN '01. 0–1秒' WHEN startup_ms<2000 THEN '02. 1–2秒' WHEN startup_ms<5000 THEN '03. 2–5秒' WHEN startup_ms<10000 THEN '04. 5–10秒' WHEN startup_ms<20000 THEN '05. 10–20秒' WHEN startup_ms<40000 THEN '06. 20–40秒' ELSE '07. 40秒及以上' END AS "耗时区间",count(*) AS "成功样本数" FROM miniapp_analytics.drama_playback_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen_at) AND first_seen_at>=now()-interval '14 days' AND environment=${environment:sqlstring}
AND (${release:sqlstring}='__all__' OR client_release=${release:sqlstring})
AND (${platform:sqlstring}='__all__' OR platform=${platform:sqlstring})
AND (${entry:sqlstring}='__all__' OR entry=${entry:sqlstring})
AND (${video:sqlstring}='__all__' OR video_id=${video:sqlstring})
AND (${measurement:sqlstring}='__all__' OR measurement_version::text=${measurement:sqlstring})
AND (${frame:sqlstring}='__all__' OR frame_method=${frame:sqlstring}) AND outcome='playing' AND startup_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 慢观察的主要等待阶段（完整主线子集）
panels.description: 每个观察只选其最大互斥区间；仅阶段归类，不能直接认定网络/解码根因。未覆盖样本看阶段完成N。

targets.rawSql:
WITH f AS (SELECT * FROM miniapp_analytics.drama_playback_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen_at) AND first_seen_at>=now()-interval '14 days' AND environment=${environment:sqlstring}
AND (${release:sqlstring}='__all__' OR client_release=${release:sqlstring})
AND (${platform:sqlstring}='__all__' OR platform=${platform:sqlstring})
AND (${entry:sqlstring}='__all__' OR entry=${entry:sqlstring})
AND (${video:sqlstring}='__all__' OR video_id=${video:sqlstring})
AND (${measurement:sqlstring}='__all__' OR measurement_version::text=${measurement:sqlstring})
AND (${frame:sqlstring}='__all__' OR frame_method=${frame:sqlstring}) AND outcome='playing' AND startup_ms>=10000 AND metadata_to_data_ms IS NOT NULL AND data_to_frame_ms IS NOT NULL AND source_to_metadata_ms IS NOT NULL AND frame_to_startup_ms IS NOT NULL) SELECT biggest.stage AS "主要等待阶段",count(*) AS "慢样本数",avg(biggest.ms/nullif(startup_ms,0))*100 AS "平均占启动百分比" FROM f CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('进入→设置源',entry_to_source_ms),('源→元数据',source_to_metadata_ms),('元数据→画面数据',metadata_to_data_ms),('画面数据→首帧',data_to_frame_ms),('首帧→启动完成',frame_to_startup_ms)) v(stage,ms) ORDER BY ms DESC LIMIT 1) biggest GROUP BY biggest.stage

panels.title: 重点诊断：网络／帧处理／主线程（毫秒）
panels.description: TTFB含网络/边缘/源站，连接段可能含TLS。缺失不是0，网络可见子集不能外推全部平台。

targets.rawSql:
WITH f AS (SELECT * FROM miniapp_analytics.drama_playback_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen_at) AND first_seen_at>=now()-interval '14 days' AND environment=${environment:sqlstring}
AND (${release:sqlstring}='__all__' OR client_release=${release:sqlstring})
AND (${platform:sqlstring}='__all__' OR platform=${platform:sqlstring})
AND (${entry:sqlstring}='__all__' OR entry=${entry:sqlstring})
AND (${video:sqlstring}='__all__' OR video_id=${video:sqlstring})
AND (${measurement:sqlstring}='__all__' OR measurement_version::text=${measurement:sqlstring})
AND (${frame:sqlstring}='__all__' OR frame_method=${frame:sqlstring})) SELECT metric AS "指标",count(ms) AS "可观测N",count(*) AS "已知观察N",percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY ms) AS "P50_ms",percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY ms) AS "P95_ms",max(ms) AS "最大_ms" FROM f CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('首个可读请求TTFB',first_ttfb_ms),('可读请求最大TTFB',max_ttfb_ms),('可读请求最大连接段',max_connect_ms),('元数据→首帧',metadata_to_frame_ms),('首帧处理',frame_processing_ms),('元数据→首帧重叠长任务',metadata_frame_longtask_ms)) v(metric,ms) GROUP BY metric

panels.title: 结果与慢比例：分母分开
panels.description: ≥10秒为诊断阈值，不中断播放。24小时本身不能保证置信，重复会话/视频非独立样本。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "已知观察N",count(*) FILTER(WHERE outcome='playing' AND startup_ms IS NOT NULL) AS "可测成功N",count(*) FILTER(WHERE outcome='playing' AND startup_ms>=10000) AS "成功慢N",100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE outcome='playing' AND startup_ms>=10000)/nullif(count(*) FILTER(WHERE outcome='playing' AND startup_ms IS NOT NULL),0) AS "成功样本慢百分比",count(*) FILTER(WHERE slow_received_at IS NOT NULL OR elapsed_ms>=10000) AS "已知等待至少10秒N" FROM miniapp_analytics.drama_playback_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen_at) AND first_seen_at>=now()-interval '14 days' AND environment=${environment:sqlstring}
AND (${release:sqlstring}='__all__' OR client_release=${release:sqlstring})
AND (${platform:sqlstring}='__all__' OR platform=${platform:sqlstring})
AND (${entry:sqlstring}='__all__' OR entry=${entry:sqlstring})
AND (${video:sqlstring}='__all__' OR video_id=${video:sqlstring})
AND (${measurement:sqlstring}='__all__' OR measurement_version::text=${measurement:sqlstring})
AND (${frame:sqlstring}='__all__' OR frame_method=${frame:sqlstring})

panels.title: 最慢／失败观察：用ID查看下方详情
panels.description: 将 observation_id 填到顶部单次观察变量；详情保留慢/失败100%、快成功确定性5%。未知终态elapsed是已知快照下界。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT observation_id,first_seen_at,outcome,entry,platform,client_release,video_id,frame_method,startup_ms,first_frame_ms,elapsed_ms,source_to_metadata_ms,metadata_to_data_ms,data_to_frame_ms,frame_to_startup_ms,network_status,max_ttfb_ms,(final_detail IS NOT NULL OR slow_detail IS NOT NULL) AS has_detailed_sample FROM miniapp_analytics.drama_playback_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen_at) AND first_seen_at>=now()-interval '14 days' AND environment=${environment:sqlstring}
AND (${release:sqlstring}='__all__' OR client_release=${release:sqlstring})
AND (${platform:sqlstring}='__all__' OR platform=${platform:sqlstring})
AND (${entry:sqlstring}='__all__' OR entry=${entry:sqlstring})
AND (${video:sqlstring}='__all__' OR video_id=${video:sqlstring})
AND (${measurement:sqlstring}='__all__' OR measurement_version::text=${measurement:sqlstring})
AND (${frame:sqlstring}='__all__' OR frame_method=${frame:sqlstring}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN outcome='playing' THEN startup_ms ELSE elapsed_ms END DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

panels.title: 单次观察：相对时间线（毫秒）
panels.description: 相对本次入口计时；网络可能并行/截断/不可见。资源详情没有Range头或签名URL。只输出所选观察。

targets.rawSql:
WITH f AS (SELECT * FROM miniapp_analytics.drama_playback_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen_at) AND first_seen_at>=now()-interval '14 days' AND environment=${environment:sqlstring}
AND (${release:sqlstring}='__all__' OR client_release=${release:sqlstring})
AND (${platform:sqlstring}='__all__' OR platform=${platform:sqlstring})
AND (${entry:sqlstring}='__all__' OR entry=${entry:sqlstring})
AND (${video:sqlstring}='__all__' OR video_id=${video:sqlstring})
AND (${measurement:sqlstring}='__all__' OR measurement_version::text=${measurement:sqlstring})
AND (${frame:sqlstring}='__all__' OR frame_method=${frame:sqlstring}) AND observation_id=${observation:sqlstring}), timeline AS (
SELECT observation_id,'mark' AS kind,k AS node,v::double precision AS start_ms,NULL::double precision AS end_ms,NULL::text AS state FROM f CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(summary->'marks') m(k,v)
UNION ALL SELECT observation_id,'media',e->>'name',(e->>'atMs')::double precision,NULL,(e->'state')::text FROM f CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(final_detail#>'{media,events}',slow_detail#>'{media,events}','[]'::jsonb)) e
UNION ALL SELECT observation_id,'network','visible_media_request',(e->>'startMs')::double precision,(e->>'responseEndMs')::double precision,e::text FROM f CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(network_detail#>'{network,entries}',final_detail#>'{diagnostics,network,entries}',slow_detail#>'{diagnostics,network,entries}','[]'::jsonb)) e
) SELECT * FROM timeline ORDER BY start_ms,kind

panels.title: 单次观察：API请求与快照证据
panels.description: queries.attempts.requestId用于Railway event=drama.request_timing关联；API headersMs不是视频TTFB。详情过期或快样本未抽中时保留summary，缺失不表示未发生。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT observation_id,summary->'marks' AS marks,diagnostic_summary,network_summary,COALESCE(final_detail->'queries',slow_detail->'queries') AS api_queries,slow_detail#>'{media,snapshot}' AS slow_snapshot,final_detail#>'{media,snapshot}' AS final_snapshot FROM miniapp_analytics.drama_playback_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen_at) AND first_seen_at>=now()-interval '14 days' AND environment=${environment:sqlstring}
AND (${release:sqlstring}='__all__' OR client_release=${release:sqlstring})
AND (${platform:sqlstring}='__all__' OR platform=${platform:sqlstring})
AND (${entry:sqlstring}='__all__' OR entry=${entry:sqlstring})
AND (${video:sqlstring}='__all__' OR video_id=${video:sqlstring})
AND (${measurement:sqlstring}='__all__' OR measurement_version::text=${measurement:sqlstring})
AND (${frame:sqlstring}='__all__' OR frame_method=${frame:sqlstring}) AND observation_id=${observation:sqlstring}
